title: Why Your Phone Dies Faster in the Cold 🥶 #shorts
description:
Is the power gone, or just hiding? Guess, then comment yes or no if you got it right.
Cold makes the liquid inside your battery thick, so lithium ions slow down. Warm it up and the battery life comes back.

Sources: Apple Support, Battery University, LG Energy Solution, BGR
